articles.titleCn: 识别阿塔里并评估先手：面向基于语言的围棋代理的控制评估任务
articles.abstractCn: 领域术语为游戏状态和战略关系提供了简洁的描述，但游戏语言模型能否准确识别这些概念并将它们与移动评估联系起来尚不清楚。我们构建了一个以围棋中的“劫”及其与“先手”关系为核心的受控评估集，考察术语识别在局部棋盘变化下的表现以及在不同战略条件下的移动评估。我们在经过术语和评注监督微调的围棋语言模型LoGos上进行了测试。该模型难以识别劫关系的变化及其战略影响。即使这些偏好与参考评估相矛盾，其术语预测也与移动偏好相关联。我们的受控测试提供了一个框架，用于检验基于语言的围棋代理是否将领域术语与精确的棋盘关系和战略移动价值联系起来。

articles.title: Aligning Language Models Towards Counterfactual Invariance
articles.abstract: Small variations in prompt characteristics can meaningfully alter the semantics, tone, and contextual assumptions of large language model outputs. Such characteristics can involve group variables such as demographics or other sensitive latent attributes. Sensitivity to such input variables is undesirable when demographic information is causally irrelevant to the task, but might still be relevant for generation of semantically coherent responses. This makes the task of enforcing counterfactual invariance while preserving model utility difficult. To study this problem, we first show that standard model alignment recipes (such as reinforcement learning) increase differences in response quality across demographics, while improving overall response quality, ultimately amplifying what is known as counterfactual bias. To address this, we develop a policy gradient technique involving a group-level reward function that operates on matched pairs of counterfactual prompts. For completeness, we build a dataset of controlled counterfactual prompt pairs and design an evaluation that separately measures cases where demographic information is causally relevant to the answer. Finally, we validate our findings on several fairness benchmarks. We demonstrate that our methods reduce counterfactual differences while preserving overall response quality and that the models continue to adapt appropriately when such sensitive information is relevant.
articles.titleCn: 将语言模型对齐到反事实不变性
articles.abstractCn: 提示特征的小幅变化可能会显著改变大型语言模型输出的语义、语气和上下文假设。这些特征可能涉及群体变量，如人口统计或其他敏感的潜在属性。当人口统计信息与任务在因果关系上无关时，对这类输入变量的敏感性是不理想的，但可能仍然与生成语义连贯的响应相关。这使得在保持模型效用的情况下强制执行反事实不变性的任务变得困难。为了研究这个问题，我们首先表明，标准的模型对齐方法（如强化学习）虽然提高了整体响应质量，但也增加了不同人口群体间响应质量的差异，最终放大了所谓的反事实偏差。为了解决这个问题，我们开发了一种策略梯度技术，该技术涉及一个作用于反事实提示配对的群体级奖励函数。为了完整性，我们构建了一个受控反事实提示对的数据库，并设计了一个评估方法，该方法分别测量人口统计信息与答案在因果关系上相关的情况。最后，我们在几个公平性基准上验证了我们的发现。我们证明了我们的方法减少了反事实差异，同时保持了整体响应质量，并且当这类敏感信息相关时，模型仍然能够适当调整。

articles.title: Beyond Surface Cues: Robust LLM-Generated Korean Text Detection
articles.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) generate increasingly fluent text, the need for reliable detection of LLM-generated content has grown substantially. However, existing research remains heavily English-centric, leaving Korean largely underexplored. Moreover, current evaluations of Korean text detection often rely on superficial cues, leading to overly optimistic estimates of detection performance. To address these limitations, we introduce \textsc{KoLing}, a bias-controlled adversarial benchmark comprising 50.9k instances that suppresses superficial shortcuts while preserving semantic content and separately evaluates LLM-generated and LLM-modified text detection. We further propose KoLingProbe, an interpretable detector grounded in theoretical linguistics that models Korean-specific properties across multiple linguistic levels. Experiments show that KoLingProbe substantially outperforms strong baselines on all detection tasks while remaining robust to adversarial attacks. Our analyses further reveal that integrating complementary linguistic features across multiple levels yields both improved performance and interpretability.
articles.titleCn: 超越表面线索：对鲁棒性LLM生成韩语文本的检测
articles.abstractCn: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）生成的文本越来越流畅，对LLM生成内容进行可靠检测的需求已显著增长。然而，现有研究仍高度集中于英语，导致韩语研究严重不足。此外，当前韩语文本检测评估往往依赖表面线索，导致对检测性能的估计过于乐观。为解决这些局限，我们引入了\textsc{KoLing}，这是一个包含50.9k实例的偏差控制对抗基准，它抑制了表面捷径，同时保留了语义内容，并分别评估LLM生成文本和LLM修改文本的检测。我们进一步提出了KoLingProbe，这是一种基于理论语言学的可解释检测器，能够在多个语言层面建模韩语特有的属性。实验表明，KoLingProbe在所有检测任务上都显著优于强基线，同时仍能抵抗对抗攻击。我们的分析进一步揭示，整合多个层面的互补语言特征不仅能提升性能，还能增强可解释性。

articles.title: Many Biases, One Circuit: Post-Training Tunes a Pretrained Cue-Routing Mechanism
articles.abstract: Language models often abandon a correct answer when the prompt contains a cue, a hint toward a wrong option such as "I think the answer is B." Sycophancy and related biases show this failure. They are often studied separately and blamed on alignment. We test this view causally, tracing the attention heads behind these biases through the stages of two post-training pipelines. In multiple-choice tests on most models, four cue types rely largely on the same few heads, a shared circuit already present in pretrained models. Most base models follow cues in plain text. Fine-tuning a base model on about 200 generic assistant examples without cues activates these heads in chat format, so cue-following can be a side effect of assistant tuning. The final reinforcement learning (RL) stage strengthens the effect of cues in almost every comparison. In Tulu-3-8B and OLMo-2-7B, we swap the attention patterns of six middle layers between the RL checkpoint and its predecessor. For suggested-answer cues, this shifts each checkpoint's cue effect most of the way to the other's level. Post-training thus seems to change when and how strongly models use this circuit. Mitigation for these multiple-choice biases could target this circuit.
articles.titleCn: 多种偏见，一个电路：训练后调整预训练的提示路由机制
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型在提示中包含线索（例如“我认为答案是B”）时，往往会放弃正确答案。谄媚行为和相关偏见展示了这种失效现象。它们通常被单独研究并归咎于对齐问题。我们通过追踪这些偏见背后的注意力头在两个后训练管道阶段的变化，对这一观点进行了因果检验。在大多数模型的多项选择题测试中，四种线索类型主要依赖于少数几个相同的头，这些共享的电路已经存在于预训练模型中。大多数基础模型会遵循纯文本中的线索。在约200个不含线索的通用助手示例上微调基础模型，可以激活这些头在聊天格式中的状态，因此遵循线索可能是助手微调的副作用。最终的强化学习（RL）阶段几乎在所有比较中增强了线索的影响。在Tulu-3-8B和OLMo-2-7B模型中，我们将RL检查点与其前身之间六个中间层的注意力模式进行交换。对于建议答案线索，这将每个检查点的线索效果大部分调整到另一个检查点的水平。因此，后训练似乎改变了模型使用该电路的时间和强度。针对这些多项选择偏见的缓解措施可能需要针对这个电路进行。

articles.title: ASR-Style Transcript Normalization Removes Useful Pragmatic Signal for Dialogue Act Classification
articles.abstract: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) pipelines often normalize transcripts by removing filled pauses and punctuation and expanding colloquial forms, potentially discarding cues useful for dialogue act classification. We evaluate nine transcript conditions across six classifiers (TF-IDF logistic regression, RoBERTa, BERT, ALBERT, GPT-2, and BiLSTM) and three conversational corpora (Switchboard, ICSI MRDA, and SLUE-HVB), supplemented by multi-seed experiments, normalization controls, and real-ASR evaluations. Across five random seeds, heavy normalization reduces Macro-F1 in all 15 neural model-corpus combinations under the original preprocessing protocols. Removal using the original filler and backchannel lexicon consistently degrades performance on MRDA and SLUE-HVB but produces mixed effects on Switchboard. Punctuation-aware TF-IDF experiments show that punctuation removal reduces Macro-F1 by 0.036 on Switchboard and 0.078 on MRDA, demonstrating that the original linear baseline's apparent insensitivity resulted from tokenization. Restricting filler removal to um, uh, and erm preserves degradation on MRDA but largely eliminates the SLUE-HVB effect, where the original lexicon removes class-defining backchannel expressions. These findings demonstrate that normalization effects depend on preprocessing definitions, feature extraction, and conversational context, supporting task-dependent rather than indiscriminate transcript normalization.
articles.titleCn: ASR-Style文本规范化移除了对话行为分类有用的语用信号
articles.abstractCn: 自动语音识别（ASR）流程通常通过移除填充停顿和标点符号以及扩展口语形式来规范化文本，这可能会丢弃对对话行为分类有用的线索。我们评估了九种文本条件在六种分类器（TF-IDF逻辑回归、RoBERTa、BERT、ALBERT、GPT-2和BiLSTM）和三种对话语料库（Switchboard、ICSI MRDA和SLUE-HVB）上的表现，并辅以多种子实验、规范化对照和真实ASR评估。在五个随机种子下，重度规范化在原始预处理协议下的所有15种神经模型-语料库组合中均降低了Macro-F1。使用原始填充词和后援词库的移除操作始终在MRDA和SLUE-HVB上降低性能，但在Switchboard上效果不一。标点敏感TF-IDF实验表明，移除标点符号使Switchboard的Macro-F1降低了0.036，MRDA降低了0.078，这表明原始线性基线的表面不敏感性源于分词。将填充词移除限制为“um”、“uh”和“erm”保留了MRDA上的性能下降，但基本消除了SLUE-HVB的影响，因为原始词库移除了定义类别的后援表达。这些发现表明，规范化效果取决于预处理定义、特征提取和对话上下文，支持任务相关的而非不加区分的文本规范化。

articles.title: Sep-Latent: Separator Tokens as Natural Compression Anchors for Implicit Reasoning
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable success in complex reasoning through explicit Chain-of-Thought (CoT), but the associated computational overhead and token verbosity remain significant barriers to efficiency. While implicit reasoning in continuous latent spaces offers a promising alternative, existing methods like Coconut and CODI often rely on fixed-length latent sequences and suffer from representational collapse. In this paper, we propose Sep-Latent, an adaptive implicit reasoning framework that utilizes separator tokens as structural semantic anchors. By introducing an Attention-Decay mechanism, we force the model to aggregate and compress reasoning logic into these anchors during training. We then align explicit and implicit pathways through multi-level distillation across all layers to ensure logical consistency. Crucially, Sep-Latent enables dynamic reasoning depth by adaptively terminating the latent thinking phase based on query complexity. Experimental results on the GSM8k-Aug benchmark show that Sep-Latent achieves an accuracy of 56.8\% with an average of only 5.4 tokens, significantly outperforming prior fixed-length implicit models in efficiency while narrowing the performance gap with explicit CoT. Further analysis via PCA and symbolic variant testing confirms that our method ensures semantic grounding and exhibits superior robustness to perturbations.
articles.titleCn: Sep-Latent：分隔符作为自然压缩锚点，用于隐式推理
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）通过显式思维链（CoT）在复杂推理方面展现出显著的成功，但其相关的计算开销和标记冗长仍然是效率提升的重大障碍。虽然连续潜在空间中的隐式推理提供了有前景的替代方案，但现有的方法如Coconut和CODI通常依赖于固定长度的潜在序列，并存在表示崩溃问题。在本文中，我们提出了Sep-Latent，一个自适应隐式推理框架，该框架利用分隔符标记作为结构化语义锚点。通过引入注意力衰减机制，我们迫使模型在训练过程中将推理逻辑聚合并压缩到这些锚点中。然后，我们通过跨所有层的多级蒸馏来对齐显式和隐式路径，以确保逻辑一致性。关键的是，Sep-Latent能够通过根据查询复杂度自适应地终止潜在思考阶段来实现动态推理深度。在GSM8k-Aug基准测试上的实验结果表明，Sep-Latent实现了56.8%的准确率，平均仅使用5.4个标记，在效率方面显著优于先前的固定长度隐式模型，同时缩小了与显式CoT的性能差距。通过PCA和符号变体测试的进一步分析证实，我们的方法确保了语义基础，并表现出对扰动的优越鲁棒性。

articles.title: Where's the Indirect Evidence? Investigating Grammatical Generalization with Influence Functions
articles.abstract: Language models generalize beyond their training corpus to learn linguistic phenomena (Patil et al., 2024; Misra and Mahowald, 2024), showing that there exists indirect evidence driving learning. Prior work has inferred that indirect evidence exists without identifying its character or considered specific hypotheses about what it might be. We explore an alternative bottom-up method for identifying indirect evidence. We use influence functions (Koh and Liang, 2017) to measure how individual training sentences affect model predictions in 15 grammatical phenomena from BLiMP (Warstadt et al., 2020). We filter out a phenomenon's direct evidence using hand-constructed rules and take the 60,000 most influential remaining sentences as indirect evidence. This indirect evidence substantially affects learning: retraining without it lowers held-out accuracy more than removing a matched random group for every phenomenon across five models (by a median of 12 points). We characterize the indirect evidence by its similarity to our direct evidence filters: it (partially) meets the filters' structural conditions at a median of 4.7 times the rate of a matched random group. Finally, clustering phenomena by indirect-evidence overlap recovers three of the five BLiMP categories that include multiple phenomena, suggesting that this method can reveal linguistic relationships.

articles.titleCn: 间接证据在哪里？通过影响函数探究语法泛化
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型能够超越其训练语料库来学习语言现象（Patil等人，2024；Misra和Mahowald，2024），这表明存在间接证据驱动学习。先前研究已推断间接证据的存在，但未明确其特征，也未考虑关于其可能性的具体假设。我们探索了一种替代性的自下而上的方法来识别间接证据。我们使用影响函数（Koh和Liang，2017）来测量单个训练句在BLiMP（Warstadt等人，2020）中的15种语法现象对模型预测的影响。我们使用手工构建的规则过滤掉现象的直接证据，并选取剩余影响最大的60,000个句子作为间接证据。这种间接证据对学习有显著影响：不包含它的重新训练会导致保留集准确率降低，其程度超过在五个模型中为每个现象移除匹配的随机组（中位数为12个百分点）。我们通过其与直接证据过滤器的相似性来描述间接证据：它在匹配随机组的中位数4.7倍速率下（部分）满足过滤器的结构条件。最后，通过间接证据重叠对现象进行聚类，恢复了包含多个现象的BLiMP五类中的三类，表明该方法能够揭示语言关系。

articles.title: FederatedBytes: Tokenizer-Free, Byte-Level Small Language Models for Efficient Multimodal Federated Learning
articles.abstract: Federated Learning (FL) is a powerful machine learning framework that allows building a global model from the contributions of multiple, distributed clients, while ensuring the privacy of their local data. However, its heavy computational and communication overheads challenge its use for contemporary AI workloads such as natural language processing (NLP) and multimodal analysis. For this reason, this paper presents a novel small language model that leverages byte-level text and multimodal data processing, enhanced by a linear attention mechanism, to enable manageable Federated Learning of NLP and multimodal analysis tasks. The proposed model, nicknamed FederatedBytes, manages to process text and any other data types, including images, by treating its input as a mere sequence of bytes, while its lean linear attention mechanism allows abating the overall memory and computational footprint. To prove the effectiveness of the proposed model we have carried out an extensive performance evaluation on sentiment analysis tasks in multilingual and multimodal settings over the Multilingual Amazon Reviews and ScienceQA datasets. The experimental results show that FederatedBytes has been able to outperform comparable models such as ByT5 and LSTM, achieving higher accuracy while significantly reducing memory and communication overheads.
articles.titleCn: 联邦字节：无需分词器、字节级小型语言模型，用于高效多模态联邦学习
articles.abstractCn: 联邦学习（FL）是一种强大的机器学习框架，它允许从多个分布式客户端的贡献中构建全局模型，同时确保其本地数据的隐私。然而，其沉重的计算和通信开销挑战了它在自然语言处理（NLP）和多模态分析等现代人工智能工作负载中的应用。为此，本文提出了一种新型小型语言模型，该模型利用字节级文本和多模态数据处理，并通过线性注意力机制进行增强，以实现可管理的NLP和多模态分析任务的联邦学习。所提出的模型，别名为联邦字节（FederatedBytes），通过将其输入视为纯粹的字节序列，能够处理文本和任何其他数据类型，包括图像，而其精简的线性注意力机制则允许减少整体内存和计算开销。为了证明所提出模型的有效性，我们在多语言和多模态环境下的情感分析任务上对多语言亚马逊评论和科学问答（ScienceQA）数据集进行了广泛的性能评估。实验结果表明，联邦字节能够优于ByT5和LSTM等可比模型，在实现更高准确性的同时，显著降低了内存和通信开销。

articles.title: Competence-Based Evaluation of Logical Reasoning in Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have brought impressive performance across diverse tasks; however, shortcomings remain in logical reasoning, including inconsistencies under linguistic variation. To improve the reasoning capacity of LLMs, we must be able to accurately measure their reasoning capacity. Current benchmarks primarily report single accuracy numbers on selected reasoning tasks. Such a performance-based evaluation methodology says little about a model's generalization capacity in reasoning. To address this limitation, we argue for a different evaluation paradigm, called competence-based evaluation (CBE), which tests whether models reliably apply the same competence across a family of problems. A parameterized generator scales complexity while keeping the required competence fixed, and matched answer-preserving presentations test correctness beyond one formulation. We instantiate CBE on elementary ordering tasks, scaling input size while varying presentations of the same ordering rule. Across six GPT and Qwen models, performance is reasonably good over bounded complexity ranges, but even strong models fail the competence condition across the tested family. Chain-of-thought and GRPO extend strong performance without resolving all tested failures; supervised LoRA shows little held-out transfer. CBE provides diagnostic profiles and an evaluation protocol that can grow with future models.
articles.titleCn: 基于能力的逻辑推理评估在大语言模型中
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的最新进展在多种任务上取得了令人印象深刻的性能；然而，在逻辑推理方面仍存在不足，包括在语言变化下的不一致性。为了提升LLMs的推理能力，我们必须能够准确测量其推理能力。当前的基准测试主要报告在选定推理任务上的单一准确率数值。这种基于性能的评估方法对于了解模型的推理泛化能力几乎毫无帮助。为了解决这一局限性，我们主张一种不同的评估范式，称为能力评估（CBE），它测试模型是否能在一系列问题中可靠地应用相同的能力。参数化生成器在保持所需能力不变的同时扩展复杂性，匹配的答案保留呈现方式测试超越单一表述的正确性。我们在基础排序任务上实例化CBE，在输入大小扩展的同时改变相同排序规则的不同呈现方式。在六个GPT和Qwen模型中，在有限的复杂性范围内性能表现合理，但即使是强大的模型在测试的问题系列中也未能通过能力条件。思维链（Chain-of-thought）和GRPO扩展了强大的性能，但并未解决所有测试中的失败；监督LoRA显示出很少的保留迁移。CBE提供了可随未来模型发展的诊断分析和评估协议。

articles.title: Bengali Hallucination Detection with Retrieval and Programs: A System Study
articles.abstract: Bengali hallucination detection must distinguish unsupported factual claims from incorrect reasoning, often without a supplied reference passage. We present and characterize an inference-only system that combines response-conditioned query rewriting, hybrid retrieval, and task-specific language-model judging. Six retrieval routes search question-answer and passage collections; a router directs each example to a 27B textual judge or a 14B agent that can compare retrieved answers, reason directly, or generate and execute Python. We characterize the system using version-specific code, saved predictions, execution traces, and corpus metadata from the Olikbochon challenge. Kaggle associates a displayed private macro-F1 of 0.956 with Version 2; its saved run processes 2,516 examples in 220.99 minutes on two T4 GPUs. Of 253 math-routed examples, 88 terminate through candidate matching, while execution traces expose 49 stderr-bearing run events across 35 examples. A later run changes six predictions despite identical core worker code. A bounded audit of 1,090 benchmark-related corpus records finds exact question or context overlap for 38 processed evaluation inputs, precluding an unqualified claim of corpus-independent generalization. The contribution is a concrete retrieval-and-computation judging architecture with an auditable operational characterization, not a controlled estimate of component gains. We distinguish the reported leaderboard result from independently recomputed diagnostics and identify the evidence needed for stronger effectiveness and reproducibility claims.

articles.titleCn: 基于检索和程序的孟加拉语幻觉检测：系统研究
articles.abstractCn: 孟加拉语幻觉检测必须区分不受支持的事实断言与错误的推理，通常在没有提供的参考段落的情况下进行。我们提出并描述了一个仅基于推理的系统，该系统结合了响应条件查询重写、混合检索和特定任务的语言模型判断。六条检索路径搜索问答和段落集合；一个路由器将每个示例引导至27B文本判断器或一个14B代理，后者可以比较检索到的答案、直接推理或生成并执行Python代码。我们使用Olikbochon挑战的版本特定代码、保存的预测、执行跟踪和语料库元数据来描述该系统。Kaggle将显示的私有宏观F1为0.956与版本2相关联；其保存的运行在两个T4 GPU上花费220.99分钟处理2,516个示例。在253个数学路由示例中，88个通过候选匹配终止，而执行跟踪揭示了35个示例中的49个stderr带运行事件。后续运行尽管核心工作代码相同，但改变了六个预测。对1,090个与基准相关的语料库记录的有限审计发现，38个处理的评估输入存在精确问题或上下文重叠，从而排除了语料库无关泛化的无资格声明。这项贡献是一个具体的检索与计算判断架构，具有可审计的操作特征，而不是组件收益的受控估计。我们将报告的排行榜结果与独立重新计算的诊断区分开来，并确定了需要更强的有效性和可重复性声明所需的证据。

articles.title: NLData2Opt: Benchmarking Parameter Derivation and Prediction for Modeling Optimization Problems from Natural Language and Data
articles.abstract: Formulating optimization problems from raw inputs of problem descriptions and data is time-consuming and costly. While Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a promising way to automate this process, existing benchmarks overestimate their capabilities by relying on idealized inputs where all data is relevant and complete. This diverges from reality, where data-centric reasoning is required to extract, compute, and predict parameters from noisy sources. To address this, we introduce NLData2Opt, a benchmark to evaluate LLMs on the multi-stage reasoning inherent in practical optimization workflows. NLData2Opt decomposes problems into problem descriptions and data, and requires models to (1) extract relevant parameters from data containing misleading attributes, (2) compute missing parameters derived by transforming existing data attributes, and (3) predict unavailable future values from historical observations. Evaluation results show substantial performance decline relative to existing benchmarks, indicating that benchmark progress does not directly translate to formulation accuracy in practical optimization workflows. NLData2Opt is available at https://github.com/sumarivyn/NLData2Opt.
articles.titleCn: NLData2Opt：从自然语言和数据中建模优化问题的参数推导与预测基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 从问题描述和数据的原始输入中构建优化问题既耗时又昂贵。尽管大型语言模型（LLM）为自动化这一过程提供了有前景的途径，但现有的基准通过依赖理想化的输入（其中所有数据都相关且完整）高估了它们的能力。这与现实情况相去甚远，在现实情况中需要以数据为中心的推理，才能从嘈杂的来源中提取、计算和预测参数。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了NLData2Opt，这是一个用于评估LLM在实际优化工作流程中固有的多阶段推理能力的基准。NLData2Opt将问题分解为问题描述和数据，并要求模型（1）从包含误导性属性的数据中提取相关参数，（2）通过转换现有数据属性来计算缺失参数，以及（3）根据历史观测值预测不可用的未来值。评估结果表明，与现有基准相比，性能有显著下降，这表明基准的进步并不能直接转化为实际优化工作流程中的公式化准确性。NLData2Opt可在https://github.com/sumarivyn/NLData2Opt获取。

articles.title: Batched Contextual Reinforcement II: Does RLVR Need Long Rollout Windows?
articles.abstract: Long rollout windows make reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) expensive, yet simply shortening them can remove the correctness signal: when every single-problem rollout truncates before an answer, group-relative accuracy advantages vanish. As a technical continuation of Batched Contextual Reinforcement (BCR), we study how concurrent rewards relax this dependence on long windows. Concurrent Constraint Reinforcement (CCR) places three independently verifiable problems in one capped training completion. Correct answers completed before truncation retain credit, while a shared budget encourages shorter useful reasoning without an explicit length penalty. We connect this mechanism to conditional reward- and update-variance analyses and study 4B and 8B mathematical reasoning models. Against single-problem GRPO with a 32k window, CCR with an 8,000-token window reduces tokens per training step from 975,464 to 174,957 on 4B and from 793,832 to 165,788 on 8B, saving 82.1% and 79.1%, respectively. An 8B training trace shows increasing accuracy reward alongside shorter completions. Single-problem evaluations provide supporting evidence of retained reasoning quality. These results identify reward-preserving training structure as a practical route to lower per-step cost in short-window RLVR.

articles.titleCn: 批量情境强化学习II：RLVR是否需要长回报窗口？
articles.abstractCn: 长滚动窗口使得可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）成本高昂，但简单缩短它们会消除正确性信号：当每个单一问题的滚动在得到答案前被截断时，组相对准确度优势就会消失。作为批量上下文强化（BCR）的技术延续，我们研究了并发奖励如何减轻对长窗口的依赖。并发约束强化（CCR）将三个独立可验证的问题置于一个受限制的训练完成中。在截断前完成的正确答案保留信用，而共享预算则鼓励更短的实用推理，无需显式的长度惩罚。我们将此机制与条件奖励和更新方差分析联系起来，并研究了4B和8B数学推理模型。针对32k窗口的单问题GRPO，使用8,000个token窗口的CCR将每步训练的token数从975,464减少到174,957（4B）和从793,832减少到165,788（8B），分别节省了82.1%和79.1%。一个8B训练轨迹显示准确度奖励随更短的完成而增加。单问题评估提供了保留推理质量的证据支持。这些结果将保留奖励的训练结构确立为降低短窗口RLVR每步成本的实际途径。

articles.title: Cooperation Without Adaptation: LLM Agents in a Collective-Risk Dilemma
articles.abstract: Language-model agents are increasingly deployed to act on behalf of people in settings where individual decisions shape shared outcomes. We examine whether five production models adapt their contributions to changing risks and partner behaviour, or instead follow a relatively fixed strategy. In a collective-risk dilemma game (CRG), six players contribute to a shared pool over ten rounds; if the pool falls short of its target, a catastrophe may destroy their remaining resources. Four models contributed approximately an equal share at every positive risk level, and four of the five also contributed when risk was zero, even though contributing could not improve their payoff. Explicitly stating that only the agent's own payoff mattered reduced zero-risk contributions for most models, while a more neutral prompt did not. Several models correctly identified which action offered the higher expected payoff at different risk levels, yet their contributions changed little. Against fixed partners, no model consistently chose the payoff-maximising response, and in mixed-model groups, a single agent's shortfall in the final round could cause an otherwise successful group to fail. Payoff-based selection also depended on population composition: in a single six-agent group, it favoured the model that contributed least and reduced group success, whereas in larger, randomly mixed populations, it favoured an exact fair-share model at moderate and high risk. These findings show that cooperative self-play alone is not evidence of strategic adaptability. Consistent with a machine-behaviour approach, evaluations of agents in multi-agent systems should test how they respond to incentives, partner actions, and population composition.

articles.titleCn: 无需适应的合作：集体风险困境中的大型语言模型代理
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型代理越来越多地被部署在个体决策影响共享结果的场景中。我们考察了五个生产模型是否会根据变化的风险和伙伴行为调整其贡献，还是会遵循相对固定的策略。在一个集体风险困境游戏（CRG）中，六名玩家在十轮中对一个共享资金池进行贡献；如果资金池未能达到目标，灾难可能会摧毁他们剩余的资源。四个模型在所有正风险水平下都贡献了大致相等的份额，其中四个模型在风险为零时也进行了贡献，尽管贡献并不能提高他们的收益。明确指出只有代理自身的收益重要时，大多数模型的零风险贡献减少了，而更中性的提示则没有影响。几个模型正确地识别了在不同风险水平下哪个行动能提供更高的预期收益，但它们的贡献变化不大。面对固定伙伴时，没有模型能始终选择收益最大化的响应，而在混合模型组中，单个代理在最后一轮的不足可能导致原本成功的团队失败。基于收益的选择也取决于种群组成：在一个六代理组中，它倾向于贡献最少的模型并降低团队成功，而在较大、随机混合的种群中，它在中等和高风险时倾向于一个精确的公平份额模型。这些发现表明，仅有的合作自我博弈并不能证明策略适应性。与机器行为方法一致，对多智能体系统中代理的评价应测试它们如何响应激励、伙伴行为和种群组成。

articles.title: Identify, Classify, Act: Per-Instruction Controlled Compliance for LLMs over External Data
articles.abstract: LLMs over external data face a per-instruction tension: a single document or tool return often interleaves legitimate directives with adversarial prompt injections, and the model must follow the former while rejecting the latter. Existing defenses suppress or trust all external instructions, collapsing the safety-utility frontier and forcing a choice between over-refusal and over-compliance. We argue the missing capability is \textbf{per-instruction credit attribution} and formalize it as External-Data Instruction Classification, an identify-classify-act decision over each embedded directive. We propose \textbf{EDIC}, a decomposed reward framework for per-instruction compliance. A scene-grounded pipeline injects mixed beneficial and harmful instructions with counterfactual filtering, while a generative judge is initialized by SFT and refined with GRPO to attribute compliance at the instruction level. The judge then produces a reward that separately encourages beneficial compliance and penalizes harmful compliance for RL training. Across two backbones and five benchmarks, EDIC improves both safety and utility over the strongest prior defense, lifting harmful-rejection by up to 7.7\% and Arena-Hard-Auto utility by 12.5\% on Qwen3-4B. The code repository is hosted at https://github.com/yingyingxia666/EDIC.
articles.titleCn: 识别、分类、行动：针对外部数据的指令控制式LLM合规
articles.abstractCn: 外部数据中的大型语言模型面临每条指令的紧张关系：单个文档或工具返回常常交错合法指令与对抗性提示注入，模型必须遵循前者同时拒绝后者。现有防御要么抑制要么信任所有外部指令，压缩了安全-效用边界，迫使模型在过度拒绝和过度遵从之间做出选择。我们认为缺失的能力是\textbf{每条指令的信用归因}，并将其形式化为外部数据指令分类，即对每个嵌入指令的识别-分类-执行决策。我们提出\textbf{EDIC}，一种用于每条指令遵从的分解奖励框架。场景化管道注入混合有益和有害指令，并通过反事实过滤进行筛选，同时生成式裁判器通过SFT初始化并通过GRPO细化，以在指令级别进行遵从归因。裁判器随后产生一个奖励，分别鼓励有益遵从并惩罚有害遵从，用于强化学习训练。在两个主干网络和五个基准测试中，EDIC在安全性和效用方面均优于最强的现有防御，将有害拒绝提升高达7.7%，并在Qwen3-4B上使Arena-Hard-Auto效用提升12.5%。代码库托管在https://github.com/yingyingxia666/EDIC。

articles.title: Uncertainty-Aware Budget Allocation for Efficient LLM Tree Search
articles.abstract: Tree search enhances multi-step reasoning in large language models (LLMs), yet prevailing methods expand every step with a fixed budget, irrespective of the marginal utility of expansion. We first show, across existing search algorithms, that continuations sampled from a shared intermediate state are largely duplicates and collapse to a few distinct answers. Critically, we find that the semantic dispersion of sibling actions predicts the redundancy of their downstream continuations, permitting a subtree's budget to be fixed before expansion. An information-theoretic analysis motivates this: treating the per-step budget as the Monte Carlo sample size for estimating a step's residual answer entropy, we derive a sufficient budget that shrinks with sibling dispersion. We accordingly propose $\textbf{Uncertainty-Aware Allocation}$ (UAA), a training-free framework that decouples value from uncertainty: values determine which candidates are promising, while uncertainty, estimated from sibling dispersion at no additional model cost, determines how many merit expansion, via uncertainty-aware pruning and uncertainty-aware budgeting. Across mathematical reasoning, logical reasoning, and planning benchmarks, UAA reduces token usage by up to $90\%$ and latency by up to $9\times$ at comparable accuracy, generalizing across four tree search algorithms and both open- and closed-source LLMs.
articles.titleCn: 不确定性感知预算分配以实现高效的LLM树搜索
articles.abstractCn: 树搜索增强了大型语言模型（LLM）的多步推理能力，但现有方法以固定预算扩展每一步，而不管扩展的边际效用如何。我们首先表明，在现有搜索算法中，从共享中间状态采样的延续大多是重复的，并简化为少数几个不同的答案。关键地，我们发现兄弟动作的语义分散预测了它们下游延续的冗余性，允许在扩展之前固定子树的预算。信息论分析为此提供了动机：将每步预算视为估计步骤剩余答案熵的蒙特卡洛样本量，我们推导出一个随着兄弟分散性缩小的足够预算。相应地，我们提出了$\textbf{不确定性感知分配}$（UAA），这是一个无需训练的框架，将价值与不确定性解耦：价值决定哪些候选者是前景的，而不确定性通过从兄弟分散性中估计（无需额外模型成本）来决定多少值得扩展，通过不确定性感知剪枝和不确定性感知预算。在数学推理、逻辑推理和规划基准测试中，UAA在相当准确的情况下将token使用量减少高达90%，并将延迟减少高达9倍，并泛化到四种树搜索算法和开源及闭源LLM。

articles.title: The Reliance Hypothesis: Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness Rises as Language Resource Level Falls
articles.abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) faithfulness matters for monitoring, explaining and safely deploying large language models, yet it has been studied mostly in English. Languages differ in level, the amount of text available to learn from, so models know less in lower-resource languages, which may change how much they rely on their reasoning. To our knowledge, we are the first to relate CoT faithfulness to both resource level and task type (knowledge- or reasoning-intensive). On parallel multiple-choice questions from Multilingual Massive Multitask Language Understanding (MMMLU) in eight languages, faithfulness rises as resource level falls on knowledge-intensive tasks but not on reasoning-intensive ones, a gap that points the same way across four models and several faithfulness measures. We propose, and find support for, the Reliance Hypothesis: models rely more on their reasoning when they cannot recall the answer, as in lower-resource languages on knowledge-intensive tasks. Model confidence partly explains the effect of resource level, but not the knowledge-reasoning gap. Languages in which models are less confident rely more on reasoning, yet less confident answers within a language do not, a Simpson's paradox. In lower-resource languages, models rely on their reasoning for more answers, not more strongly for each. CoT monitoring may therefore be most informative in lower-resource languages, where it is least often validated.

articles.titleCn: 依赖假说：当语言资源水平下降时，思维链的忠实度会提高
articles.abstractCn: 思维链（CoT）的忠实度对于监控、解释和安全部署大型语言模型至关重要，然而它主要是在英语中研究的。语言在水平、可学习的文本数量上存在差异，因此模型在低资源语言中知道得较少，这可能改变它们对推理的依赖程度。据我们所知，我们是第一个将CoT忠实度与资源水平和任务类型（知识密集型或推理密集型）相关联的研究。在八种语言的Multilingual Massive Multitask Language Understanding（MMMLU）平行多项选择题中，忠实度在知识密集型任务上随着资源水平的下降而上升，但在推理密集型任务上则不然，这种差异在四种模型和几种忠实度度量标准中均指向同一方向。我们提出了依赖假说，并得到了支持：当模型无法回忆答案时，它们会更多地依赖推理，这在低资源语言的知识密集型任务中尤为明显。模型置信度部分解释了资源水平的影响，但无法解释知识-推理差距。在模型置信度较低的语言中，它们更多地依赖推理，但在同一语言内，置信度较低的答案则不然，这是一个辛普森悖论。在低资源语言中，模型对更多答案依赖推理，而不是对每个答案更强依赖。因此，CoT监控可能在低资源语言中最具信息量，而这些语言恰恰是最少被验证的。

articles.title: Too Emotional to Be Fake? Intra-Utterance Emotion Shifts Expose Failure Modes in Speech Deepfake Detectors
articles.abstract: Expressive speech synthesis can now change emotion within a single utterance, yet its impact on deepfake detection remains unclear. We introduce EmoShift, a benchmark comparing emotion-stable (AA) and emotion-changing (AB) speech to examine these effects while accounting for static emotion identity and acoustic confounds. It comprises 7,240 bona fide utterances from four source datasets and 9,720 synthetic utterances generated using four expressive TTS systems. Across seven detectors, we find that emotion changes can make synthetic speech appear more genuine, increasing spoof miss rates by up to 25.3 percentage points on OMG-Emotion at fixed thresholds. Conversely, emotion-changing bona fide speech increases false-alarm rates by up to 24.4 percentage points on IEMOCAP. Further analyses reveal detector-specific sensitivities to emotion trajectories, not fully explained by static emotion identity or splicing artifacts. These findings underscore the importance of emotion dynamics in deepfake detection.
articles.comment: Preprint. Under review
articles.titleCn: 过于情绪化而难以伪装？语句内情绪变化揭露语音深度伪造检测器的失效模式
articles.abstractCn: 当前，表达性语音合成技术能够改变单次话语中的情感，但其对深度伪造检测的影响尚不明确。我们引入了EmoShift基准，通过比较情感稳定（AA）和情感变化（AB）的语音，在考虑静态情感身份和声学混杂因素的同时，检验这些影响。该基准包含来自四个源数据集的7,240个真实话语，以及使用四种表达性TTS系统生成的9,720个合成话语。在七个检测器上，我们发现情感变化可以使合成语音看起来更真实，在OMG-Emotion上，固定阈值下使欺骗误报率增加了高达25.3个百分点。相反，情感变化的真实语音在IEMOCAP上使虚警率增加了高达24.4个百分点。进一步分析揭示了检测器对情感轨迹的特定敏感性，这无法完全由静态情感身份或拼接伪影解释。这些发现强调了情感动态在深度伪造检测中的重要性。

articles.title: Causal Edit Serialization
articles.abstract: Standard autoregressive language models generate text sequentially, but revision requires referring back to tokens in the input context or those already generated. Causal Edit Serialization (CES) is introduced as a framework for expressing such revisions within the same causal token stream. Special pointer tokens are paired with predicted source addresses, allowing insertion, deletion, replacement, copying and movement to be localized explicitly. A lightweight localization head and dual-index rotary position encoding support both address prediction and conditioning on previously emitted pointers, while retaining a standard causal attention mask. A pretraining procedure combines ordinary language modeling with serialized repairs derived from random corruptions, model-generated edits and repeated text. Across model scales and editing baselines, CES models demonstrate complete applied edits with modestly higher clean-text bits per byte than clean autoregressive models. Supervised and reinforcement-learning post-training provide a grammatical-error-correction proof of concept, producing more beneficial than harmful changes under reference-blind model judging. Correct repair programs also improve subsequent text prediction while the original context and its cached states are retained. CES provides a common interface for generation and localized revision, with potential extensions to iterative refinement and additional pointer-addressed transformations.

articles.titleCn: 因果编辑序列化
articles.abstractCn: 标准自回归语言模型按顺序生成文本，但修订需要参考输入上下文中的标记或已生成的标记。因果编辑序列化（CES）被引入作为在同一因果标记流中表达此类修订的框架。特殊的指针标记与预测的源地址配对，允许明确地进行插入、删除、替换、复制和移动。轻量级定位头和双索引旋转位置编码支持地址预测，并在依赖先前发出的指针的同时保留标准的因果注意力掩码。预训练过程结合了常规语言建模与从随机损坏、模型生成的编辑和重复文本中派生的序列化修复。在模型规模和编辑基线方面，CES模型展示了完整的应用编辑，其干净文本每字节的比特数比干净的自回归模型略高。监督学习和强化学习后训练提供了一个语法错误校正的概念验证，在参考盲模型评判下产生的改变比有害的改变更有益。正确的修复程序同时提高了后续文本预测，同时保留了原始上下文及其缓存状态。CES为生成和局部化修订提供了通用接口，并具有扩展到迭代细化和其他指针地址转换的潜力。

articles.title: Watermarkability: Measuring and Improving Language-Model Compatibility with Logit-Based Watermarks
articles.abstract: Language-model watermarks can help identify model-generated text, encode provenance information, and detect post-generation edits. A broad class of logit-based watermarks increases the logits of a designated token set at each decoding step. Because a base model's native probability mass on this set varies across contexts, models, and watermark rules, the same logit bias can yield different adherence rates and increases in perplexity (PPL). We introduce watermarkability to characterize the compatibility between a model and the token sets requested by a watermark. At a target mass $τ$, we quantify this property through a watermarkability cost: the expected minimum KL divergence from the base-model distribution required to assign probability at least $τ$ to the requested set. A lower cost means that the model is more watermarkable for that request distribution. To reduce this cost, we propose a two-stage method. In the first stage, we train a target-set-conditioned low-rank adapter on unions drawn from a 16-way vocabulary partition to increase the requested set's probability mass. In the second stage, a closed-form controller applies the smallest remaining uniform logit bias needed to reach the target mass. We evaluate the method on six watermark schedules using OPT-125M and Qwen3-8B. Across the 12 model-schedule pairs, the pre-adaptation watermarkability cost correlates with the log-PPL increase under a near-hard fixed-bias baseline (pooled Pearson $r=0.929$). For every schedule, at least 99.80% of sampled tokens fall in the target set requested at their decoding step. At this reliability, the adapter and controller reduce average per-schedule prompt-conditional PPL by 46.3% on OPT-125M and 5.2% on Qwen3-8B relative to the fixed-bias baseline.

articles.titleCn: 水印可检测性：测量和提升语言模型与基于 logits 的水印的兼容性
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型水印有助于识别模型生成的文本、编码来源信息以及检测生成后的编辑。一类基于logit的水印通过在每个解码步骤中增加指定token集的logit值来实现。由于基础模型在这些集合上的原生概率质量随上下文、模型和水印规则的变化而变化，相同的logit偏差可能导致不同的遵循率和困惑度（PPL）的增加。我们引入水印适应性来表征模型与水印请求的token集之间的兼容性。在目标质量τ下，我们通过水印适应性成本来量化这一特性：即分配至少τ概率到请求集合所需的基础模型分布的最小KL散度的期望值。成本越低，意味着模型在该请求分布下越容易添加水印。为了降低这一成本，我们提出了一种两阶段方法。在第一阶段，我们在16向词汇划分的并集上训练一个目标集条件化的低秩适配器，以增加请求集合的概率质量。在第二阶段，一个封闭形式的控制器应用最小的剩余均匀logit偏差以达到目标质量。我们使用OPT-125M和Qwen3-8B在六种水印时间表上评估该方法。在12个模型-时间表对中，预适配的水印适应性成本与在近乎固定的偏差基线下的log-PPL增加相关（合并皮尔逊r=0.929）。对于每种时间表，至少99.80%的采样token在其解码步骤中落在请求的目标集合中。在这种可靠性下，适配器和控制器相对于固定偏差基线，将OPT-125M的平均每时间表提示条件PPL降低了46.3%，Qwen3-8B降低了5.2%。

articles.title: On the Position Bias of Large Language Models: A Comprehensive Study
articles.abstract: Recent studies have shown that position bias remains a critical vulnerability in large language models (LLMs), undermining both the integrity of multiple-choice evaluations and the reliability of retrieval-augmented generation. However, existing understanding of this phenomenon is largely derived from studies with limited model coverage and English-centric benchmarks, leaving the behavior of frontier models and diverse languages underexplored. In this work, we conduct a comprehensive investigation of position bias across model scales ranging from billion-level to trillion-level parameters, covering both multiple-choice and multi-document tasks in five languages. Our experiments reveal that while position bias remains noticeable in small-scale models and Non-English languages, increasing model scale and employing standard Chain-of-Thought prompting significantly mitigate this issue. Moreover, we demonstrate that emerging \emph{thinking models} with extended reasoning capabilities are nearly immune to position bias, suggesting a costly but general approach toward resolving this vulnerability.
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型的立场偏差：一项全面研究
articles.abstractCn: 近期研究表明，位置偏差仍然是大型语言模型（LLMs）中的一个关键漏洞，它损害了多项选择题评估的完整性和检索增强生成的可靠性。然而，对这一现象的现有理解主要基于模型覆盖范围有限且以英语为中心的基准研究，导致前沿模型和多种语言的行为尚未得到充分探索。在本工作中，我们对跨越十亿级到万亿级参数规模的模型进行全面研究，涵盖了五种语言的多项选择题和多文档任务。实验表明，虽然在小规模模型和非英语语言中位置偏差仍然明显，但增加模型规模和采用标准思维链提示可以显著缓解这一问题。此外，我们证明具有扩展推理能力的新兴思维模型几乎不受位置偏差的影响，这表明了一种代价高昂但通用的解决这一漏洞的方法。

articles.title: Veil-Then-Reveal: Protecting PII Privacy via Reversible Pseudo-Anonymization in Zero-Trust User--LLM Interaction
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly process sensitive documents and personal information, yet sending prompts containing personally identifiable information (PII) to remote providers exposes data subjects and organizations to risks from logging, retention, model training, and unintended disclosure. Existing anonymization methods often mask or remove PII, while conventional encryption eliminates the lexical and structural cues needed for effective LLM processing. We present Veil-then-Reveal (VtR), a user-side PII pseudo-anonymization framework for privacy-preserving LLM interaction under a zero-trust threat model. VtR treats remote LLM providers as untrusted and sends only pseudo-anonymized prompts, keeping plaintext PII on the user. VtR first detects PII and replaces it with realistic, same-type, in-vocabulary surrogates before prompts leave the user's device, preserving their linguistic and structural properties. It combines format-preserving encryption (FPE) for structured PII, such as phone and credit-card numbers, with a keyed-hash dictionary and secure vault for semantic PII, such as names, locations, and organizations. Session-specific mappings provide cross-session unlinkability, while user-side restoration reversibly replaces surrogates with their original values in LLM responses. We further introduce a rank-class FPE strategy for dates that preserves format and ambiguity while reducing cipher evaluations. Evaluation on three datasets containing 11,322 annotated PII instances achieves 97.9% detection recall, 95.2% protection of detected values, and 99.9% round trip; 100% of echoed surrogates end-to-end round-trip restoration.
articles.titleCn: 遮蔽-揭示：通过可逆伪匿名化保护个人身份信息隐私的零信任用户-大型语言模型交互
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地处理敏感文档和个人信息，然而将包含个人身份信息（PII）的提示发送给远程提供商会使数据主体和组织面临日志记录、保留、模型训练和非预期披露的风险。现有的匿名化方法通常掩盖或删除PII，而传统加密则会消除有效LLM处理所需的词汇和结构线索。我们提出了Veil-then-Reveal（VtR），这是一个用于在零信任威胁模型下保护隐私的LLM交互的用户端PII伪匿名化框架。VtR将远程LLM提供方视为不可信的，并且只发送伪匿名化提示，将明文PII保留在用户端。VtR首先检测PII，并在提示离开用户设备之前将其替换为真实、同类、词汇内的替代品，以保留其语言和结构属性。它结合了对结构化PII（如电话号码和信用卡号）的格式保持加密（FPE），以及对语义PII（如姓名、位置和组织）的键控哈希字典和安全保险库。会话特定的映射提供了跨会话的无链接性，而用户端的恢复功能可逆地替换LLM响应中的替代品为其原始值。我们进一步引入了一种针对日期的秩类FPE策略，该策略在保持格式和模糊性的同时减少了加密评估次数。在包含11,322个标注PII实例的三个数据集上的评估达到了97.9%的检测召回率、95.2%的检测值保护率和99.9%的往返率；100%的回声替代品实现了端到端的往返恢复。

articles.title: Reasoning Reranking with Semantic IDs as the Sole Item Representation
articles.abstract: Reasoning rerankers write a rationale before ranking a candidate slate, and existing systems read item metadata to do so, even though generative recommenders increasingly represent items as compact Semantic IDs (SIDs). Ranking from SIDs alone has two appeals: SID prompts are far shorter than the matched item text, and although item codes are fixed from content, the backbone learns their token embeddings in part from user-item interaction sequences, so the tokens can carry behavioral signal that item text lacks. That training targets next-item generation, and whether it supports ranking a supplied slate from SIDs alone is untested. We build ReRankID, a controlled testbed in which models reason and rank from a history and slate shown only as SIDs, varying item rendering, history length, and slate size one at a time. On this testbed, such models often copy the input order instead of reranking, and readable metadata does not repair the failure. We compare supervised fine-tuning, rejection-sampled self-training, on-policy distillation, and verifier-based reinforcement learning as post-training methods and find that they elicit the missing behavior. The strongest post-trained model, the 8B model trained with a graded ranking reward, gives the best SID-only ranking and matches strong text-reading LLMs whose prompts are about 20x longer. It ranks above random with no history at all, where a caption-reading reference does not, and it keeps its gains at long histories, where text prompts pass 50k tokens and the caption-reading reference stops improving. In a paired rationale audit, this model argues trade-offs better than that reference but describes items less accurately. The common post-training methods we test thus elicit ranking from SIDs but not faithful item descriptions, which calls for post-training that improves the reasoning itself, not only the ranking it produces.

articles.titleCn: 基于语义ID作为唯一项目表示的推理重排序
articles.abstractCn: 推理重排序器在排序候选集之前会撰写推理依据，而现有系统通过读取物品元数据来实现这一功能，尽管生成式推荐系统越来越多地将物品表示为紧凑的语义ID（SIDs）。仅从SIDs进行排序有两个优势：SID提示远比匹配的物品文本短，而且虽然物品代码从内容中固定，但骨干网络部分从用户-物品交互序列中学习它们的token嵌入，因此这些token可以携带行为信号，而物品文本则缺乏这种信号。该训练目标是下一物品生成，而它是否支持仅从SIDs对提供的候选集进行排序尚未得到验证。我们构建了ReRankID，这是一个受控的测试平台，其中模型仅以SIDs形式展示历史记录和候选集进行推理和排序，并逐一改变物品渲染方式、历史记录长度和候选集大小。在这个测试平台上，此类模型通常会复制输入顺序而不是重新排序，可读的元数据也无法修复这种失败。我们将监督微调、拒绝采样自训练、在线蒸馏和基于验证器的强化学习作为后训练方法进行比较，发现它们都能引出缺失的行为。最强的后训练模型——使用分级排序奖励训练的8B模型——给出了最佳的仅SID排序，并匹配了强文本读取LLM，其提示长度约为20倍。该模型在没有历史记录的情况下也能优于随机排序，而一个标题读取参考则不能，并且它在长历史记录中保持其优势，当文本提示超过50k个token时，标题读取参考停止改进。在一对推理审计中，该模型比参考模型更好地论证权衡，但描述物品的准确性较低。我们测试的常见后训练方法虽然能引出从SIDs进行排序，但无法实现忠实的物品描述，这要求后训练不仅要改进它产生的排序，还要改进其推理本身。

articles.title: Causal Latent Workspaces for Looped Transformers
articles.abstract: Reusing a Transformer block across depth increases computation without replicating its parameters, but successive passes have no dedicated state through which positions can exchange compact summaries of their causal prefix. We introduce the causal latent workspace Transformer: an anchored, four-round shared-depth architecture in which each position writes gated vectors into prefix-specific latent slots and retrieves a content-addressed summary before the next shared block application. This path complements causal self-attention while the original input embedding remains accessible at every round. Across three byte-level corpora, three seeds, and two matched parameter budgets, the proposed model achieves the best mean held-out perplexity in five of six settings against five Transformer controls. At 101.71M parameters it leads on WikiText-103 raw, enwik8, and TinyStories, reaching perplexities 2.7820, 2.7843, and 1.6823; these improve upon the strongest non-workspace control on each corpus by 1.06%, 0.73%, and 1.01%. All nine seed-labelled comparisons at this budget favor the workspace. At 0.918M parameters it leads on WikiText-103 and TinyStories, whereas a conditioned loop is stronger on enwik8. Architectural ablations show that adding the workspace improves upon the anchored loop in all six settings and support refreshing its causal summaries at each round. Together, these results identify a causal, content-addressable prefix workspace as an effective structural augmentation of looped Transformers.
articles.comment: 20 pages, 5 figures. Code and reproducibility materials: https://github.com/izaznov/causal-latent-workspace-transformer
articles.titleCn: 循环Transformer的因果潜在工作空间
articles.abstractCn: 在深度中复用Transformer模块可增加计算量而不复制其参数，但连续的遍历没有专用的状态，无法让位置交换其因果前缀的紧凑摘要。我们引入了因果潜在工作空间Transformer：一种锚定的、四轮共享深度架构，其中每个位置将门控向量写入前缀特定的潜在槽，并在下一个共享块应用之前检索内容寻址的摘要。这一路径补充了因果自注意力，同时原始输入嵌入在每个轮次中保持可访问。在三个字节级语料库、三个种子和两个匹配参数预算下，所提出的模型在六个设置中的五个中，与五个Transformer对照模型相比，实现了最佳平均保留困惑度。在1.0171M参数下，它在WikiText-103原始、enwik8和TinyStories上领先，达到困惑度2.7820、2.7843和1.6823；这些改进了每个语料库上最强非工作空间对照模型的性能，分别提高了1.06%、0.73%和1.01%。在这个预算下，所有九个种子标记的比较都倾向于工作空间。在91.8M参数下，它在WikiText-103和TinyStories上领先，而在enwik8上，条件循环更强。架构消融实验表明，添加工作空间在所有六个设置中都优于锚定循环，并支持在每个轮次中刷新其因果摘要。综合这些结果，表明因果、内容寻址的前缀工作空间是循环Transformer的有效结构增强。

articles.title: Prune the Leaky Neurons: Mitigating Private Data Leakage in Fine-Tuned LLMs via Joint-Embedding-Guided Pruning
articles.abstract: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) on proprietary records enables domain adaptation but introduces two challenges: (i) privacy leakage of memorized private data, such as personally identifiable information (PII), and (ii) balancing private data removal with utility preservation. Existing defenses, including data sanitization and differential privacy, often degrade performance, while privacy-neuron editing lacks a PII-free reference to distinguish identity-specific neurons from those supporting useful text. We propose JEPA-Prune, a post-hoc neuron pruning framework guided by a model trained exclusively on PII-free views. Alongside the fine-tuned private model, JEPA-Prune, trains a public model on surrogate and masked views of the same records using a joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA), capturing domain knowledge without identifiers. A cross-model representation probe quantifies deviations between private representations of leaked records and this PII-free reference. Integrated gradients and a scale-invariant specificity score then identify PII-responsive neurons, which are pruned without retraining. Experiments show that pruning just 1.6% of neurons reduces PII inference accuracy by up to 7.4x and PII extraction recall by up to 13.9x, while keeping unseen-text perplexity within 16% of that of the unpruned model for most LLMs. In contrast, privacy-neuron editing increases perplexity by at least 26x.
articles.titleCn: 修剪泄漏神经元：通过联合嵌入引导修剪减轻微调大型语言模型的隐私数据泄漏
articles.abstractCn: 在专有记录上微调大型语言模型（LLM）可以实现领域适应，但会带来两个挑战：(i) 记忆中的私有数据（如个人身份信息（PII））的隐私泄露，以及 (ii) 平衡私有数据移除与效用保留。现有的防御措施，包括数据清理和差分隐私，往往会降低性能，而隐私神经元编辑缺乏无PII参考来区分特定身份的神经元和支持有用文本的神经元。我们提出了JEPA-Prune，这是一个由仅在无PII视图上训练的模型指导的后期神经元剪枝框架。除了微调的私有模型外，JEPA-Prune还使用联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）在相同记录的替代和掩码视图上训练一个公共模型，以捕获无标识符的领域知识。跨模型表示探测器量化了泄露记录的私有表示与该无PII参考之间的偏差。集成梯度和尺度不变特异性分数随后识别出响应PII的神经元，这些神经元在不重新训练的情况下被剪枝。实验表明，仅剪枝1.6%的神经元可将PII推理准确率降低高达7.4倍，PII提取召回率降低高达13.9倍，同时大多数LLM的未见文本困惑度保持在未剪枝模型的16%以内。相比之下，隐私神经元编辑至少使困惑度增加26倍。

articles.title: Self-Evolving Coding Agents via Harness-Policy Optimization
articles.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents have shown promising potential in coding tasks, and their performance is jointly determined by the policy model and the harness that mediates their interaction with the environment. Indeed, harness and policy are mutually reinforcing and evolving only one component is suboptimal---a harness tuned for one checkpoint may not target the failure modes of an updated policy, while policy learning remains limited to the trajectories elicited by a fixed harness. In light of this, we propose Self-HPO, a recursive self-improving framework for coding agents that alternates harness and policy optimization, using the evolving policy as its own harness proposer. Specifically, in each round, the current policy first analyzes its own failures and proposes new harness candidates (H-step). The policy is then updated through reinforcement learning (RL) under the selected harness (P-step), and hard tasks identified during training form the next harness search set, keeping harness optimization targeted to the policy's evolving failure modes. Across three coding benchmarks, Self-HPO consistently outperforms harness-only and policy-only baselines, improving Qwen3.5-35B-A3B's average resolve rate from 57.8% to 64.8%, with gains generalizing to out-of-distribution settings. Further analysis shows that both optimized components retain gains even when paired with their base counterparts, while their joint gain exceeds the sum of their individual gains. Self-HPO also improves reliability (Pass@1) and expands the capability frontier (Pass@k) over the base agent. Additionally, we show that with a stronger external model (e.g., Opus 4.8) as the harness proposer, the same framework yields a further performance boost.
articles.titleCn: 通过 harness-策略优化实现自我进化的编码代理
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理在编程任务中展现出良好的潜力，其性能由策略模型和调节其与环境交互的适配器共同决定。实际上，适配器和策略是相互促进并共同演化的，仅优化其中一个组件是不够理想的——针对某个检查点的适配器可能无法针对更新后的策略的失效模式进行优化，而策略学习则局限于由固定适配器触发的轨迹。鉴于此，我们提出了Self-HPO，一个用于编程代理的递归自改进框架，该框架交替进行适配器和策略优化，并使用演化的策略作为其自身的适配器提议者。具体而言，在每一轮中，当前策略首先分析自身的失效情况并提出新的适配器候选（H步骤）。然后，在选定的适配器下通过强化学习（RL）更新策略（P步骤），并在训练过程中识别出的硬任务将构成下一轮适配器搜索集，使适配器优化针对策略演化的失效模式。在三个编程基准测试中，Self-HPO始终优于仅优化适配器或仅优化策略的基线模型，将Qwen3.5-35B-A3B的平均解决率从57.8%提升至64.8%，且该提升泛化到分布外设置。进一步分析表明，即使与基础版本配对，优化后的组件仍能保持收益，而它们的联合收益超过了各自收益的总和。Self-HPO还提升了可靠性（Pass@1）并扩展了能力边界（Pass@k）相对于基础代理。此外，我们展示了当使用更强的外部模型（例如Opus 4.8）作为适配器提议者时，该框架能进一步带来性能提升。
